product.name: AI Medical Summaries
product.description: Converts unstructured medical records into clear, concise summaries organized into chronologies for insurance professionals.

product.name: Risk Assessment
product.description: Integrates underwriting and claims manuals to identify risk factors in medical records within seconds.

product.name: Knockout Questions
product.description: Provides instant answers to key qualification questions to determine client eligibility at the start.

product.name: Document Chat
product.description: Allows users to query medical records and receive precise answers without manually searching through documents.
